results.content: # Mathematical formulations and a Relax-and-Fix heuristic algorithm for capacitated reliable fixed-charge facility location problems. Capacity  Reliable facility location  Supply Chain Disruption  Optimisation  Relax-and-Fix heuristic. This paper addresses a novel capacitated version of the reliable fixed-charge facility location problem, where the failure probability of each facility is site-dependent, differing from existing literature models. Given the NP-hard nature of the problem, we propose a novel Relax-and-Fix heuristic for its solution.
